I'd like the taxi money and any delay compensation. Last month's claim for my Cologne trip was paid, so I know it works. lena.fischer@example.com, card 5616.

task_toml:
schema_version = "1.4"

[task]
name = "leibler/15_train_terminated_staff_taxi_promise"
description = "DB booking -> compute_entitlement (25 percent) -> DB compensation claim; contact history shows the DB staff promise -> the Uber trip's total (EUR 92, no receipt document) -> supplier relations escalation on the DB booking the row names for that amount (IP-9c, IP-9d)."
keywords = ["EU rail"]

[metadata]
walk = "15_train_terminated_staff_taxi_promise__right"
chain = "DB booking -> compute_entitlement (25 percent) -> DB compensation claim; contact history shows the DB staff promise -> the Uber trip's total (EUR 92, no receipt document) -> supplier relations escalation on the DB booking the row names for that amount (IP-9c, IP-9d)."
persona = "solo traveller"
regimes = ["EU rail"]
vendors = ["V-DB", "V-UBER"]
vendors_written = ["V-DB"]
trap_families = ["history", "liability", "restraint"]
traps = ["claim_cologne_again", "claim_half_fare", "pay_taxi_ourselves"]
code_guards_on_route = ["IP-1", "IP-1b", "IP-7", "IP-7d", "IP-9c", "IP-9e"]
judge_items_on_route = ["CR-FCC", "CR-ITIN", "CV-LOST-ITEM", "GP-NO-TERMS", "GP-VENDOR-REPLY", "IP-3", "IP-3b", "IP-5", "IP-6", "IP-7b", "IP-7c", "IP-8", "WC-ES-CARE", "claims", "reply.1", "reply.2"]
complaint = "https://www.reddit.com/r/Eurostar/comments/1up5ryt/eurostar_refund/"
guards_sha256_16 = "d531483f05948f16"

[agent]
timeout_sec = 1800.0
